meta.title: MyFamily — Private family organization
meta.description: Coordinate calendars, tasks, expenses, lists, gifts, and family documents with clear permissions and private spaces.

hero.title: One shared place for everything that keeps your family moving.
hero.subtitle: Calendars, tasks, expenses, lists, gifts, and documents with permissions that respect every private space.

modules.title: Practical tools for everyday family life
modules.description: Members and Wishlist are always on. Family administrators enable the rest according to each household's needs.

wishlist.title: Spoiler-free Wishlist
wishlist.description: Share wishes and coordinate reservations, purchases, and comments without revealing the surprise to the recipient.

planning.title: Calendar, tasks, and lists
planning.description: Organize events, assignees, due dates, and shopping with family or selected-member visibility.

expenses.title: Collection-based expenses
expenses.description: Create private spaces with their own roles, splits, recurring entries, filters, analytics, and CSV export.

private.title: Private notes and documents
private.description: Choose who can read each note or file and download documents through temporary links.

wellbeing.title: Meals and habits
wellbeing.description: Plan meals and recipes, and track personal or shared routines without public leaderboards.

planner.title: Family planner
planner.description: Bring together upcoming activity you are already allowed to see without weakening each module's privacy.

privacy.eyebrow: Privacy is not a final setting
privacy.title: Every piece of data keeps its context and permissions.
privacy.description: MyFamily checks access in the application and again in PostgreSQL. Knowing a URL does not grant access.
privacy.family_description: Owner, admin, and member roles define household administration.
privacy.collection_description: Expenses have their own ACL; family membership alone is not enough.
privacy.item_description: Notes, lists, habits, and documents can be limited to specific people.

cta.title: Start with what your family needs today.
cta.description: Create a family, invite its members, and enable only the modules your household will use.

footer.tagline: Family coordination with shared and private spaces.
